items.title: A large payment ecosystem
items.claim: February 2025: 671,340,910 transactions; value BDT 164,726.30 crore; active accounts 871.54 lac.
items.supports: Payment scale and active-account counts for this reporting month.
items.limitations: Accounts are not unique people; volume is not fraud prevalence. These values come from a web table, not the unavailable PDF.

items.title: Consumer vulnerability and redress
items.claim: PRI-hosted coverage describes a survey of 7,279 MFS users and reports roughly one in ten experienced fraud.
items.supports: Reported survey evidence of consumer-protection concerns.
items.limitations: Historical survey coverage, not current national prevalence or an APP-only rate; no fresh representative study performed.

items.title: Manipulation can precede a payment
items.claim: The article describes emotional manipulation persuading people to send money, alongside credential theft.
items.limitations: Media account, not a verified national APP count or a single classified APP incident.

items.title: Dighi bKash recovery
items.claim: TBS reports BDT 162,000 recovered after a caller impersonated bKash staff and obtained an OTP.
items.supports: A reported impersonation and OTP-compromise case.
items.limitations: Does not establish that the victim initiated a push payment; not classified as direct APP evidence.
items.feature: Verification guidance; never share PINs or OTPs
items.outcome: Two alleged fraudsters arrested; funds reportedly recovered.

items.title: Faridpur impersonation investigation
items.claim: TBS reports five arrests following alleged customer-care impersonation and PIN/OTP collection.
items.limitations: No comparable total loss amount extracted; credential compromise is not necessarily APP fraud.
items.service: bKash / Nagad and other MFS, as reported
items.outcome: Joint army/police operation; detainees handed to police.

items.title: Stolen-device recovery
items.claim: BSS reporting carried by TBS describes 363 recovered phones returned to owners.
items.limitations: Phone counts are not scam-victim counts or APP statistics; excluded from the MFS case timeline count.

notes.evidence: Public Bangladesh sources do not consistently classify fraud as Authorized Push Payment (APP) fraud. Direct APP relevance, broader MFS fraud and supporting digital-security evidence are separated.
notes.ml: Thamun model evaluation uses synthetic/simulated transaction data and does not establish real-world MFS performance.
notes.coverage: Curated evidence set, not a census of Bangladesh incidents. Unverified sources contribute no statistics.
